title: Video Downloader & Story Saver
summary: Download story and reels: video downloader and story saver without login
description:
With SavePro, you can download reels, story, post, highlight, IGTV, guide, or profile pic to your gallery. You can also download and copy biography, caption, and hashtag from any post and profile. SavePro is a reels downloader and story saver.
SavePro is a great way to save your favorite content. Whether you want to save a story to watch later or download a reel to share with your friends, this downloader has you covered.

SavePro 2026 Features:
•	Download multiple stories and highlights.
•	Merge multiple videos into one.
•	Pause and resume downloads.
•	High-quality download and save to gallery.
•	Watch offline with a built-in player.
•	Fast download speed.
•	Small app size.

Select and download multiple stories and highlights.
With this story saver, you can pick multiple stories or highlights to save and download them all together in your gallery.

Download any texts, photos, and videos.
This app is the most complete downloader that can download anything for you: Story, Highlight, Reels, Post, IGTV, Guide, Profile Picture (DP), Biography, Caption, Hashtag, …

Merge and save multiple videos into one.
With this downloader, you can merge multiple videos from a post, story, or highlight into a single video.

Download Methods
•	Share to:
1.	Click the Send button in the Instagram app.
2.	Select Share from the list of options.
3.	Select SavePro - Video Downloader.
•	Copy link:
1.	Click the Send button in the Instagram app.
2.	Select Copy link from the list of options.
3.	Open SavePro - Video Downloader and paste the link.
